# Vendored Actions Cache v2 contract

The generated files below this directory were copied without functional
changes from `actions/toolkit`:

- Repository: https://github.com/actions/toolkit
- Commit: `ffdc20ef9208b774c9a99db718b9b02c64d84e70`
- Package release: `@actions/cache` 6.2.0
- Package: `packages/cache/src/generated/results`
- Generator: `protobuf-ts 2.9.1`
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE.md` in this directory

Only the Cache v2 messages, service client, and their two metadata dependencies
are vendored. The adapter uses the JSON Twirp client so it does not duplicate
the toolkit's filesystem archive behavior.
